54a Baggot Lane is a three storey, 2 bedroom townhouse positioned in the return of 54 Pembroke Road. Access to this property is independently via pedestrian walkway to Baggot Lane.

This unique home is thoughtfully arranged over three levels and is connected by a spiral staircase throughout, creating an impressive architectural feature that adds charm and character throughout.

The bright, fully fitted kitchen is equipped with a range of wall and base units along with quality integrated appliances, while steps lead directly to the rear garden area. The contemporary shower room completes the accommodation on this level.

The first floor accommodates two generous double bedrooms with the spiral staircase connecting each level.

The spacious living room offers a superb space for relaxing and entertaining. A marble fireplace with a timber surround provides an elegant focal point, complemented by decorative cornicing and recessed ceiling lighting. Sliding patio doors open onto a private cobble-lock courtyard.

FIRST FLOOR:

BEDROOM 1
2.96m (9.8ft) x 2.37m (7.9ft)
Double bedroom with built-in wardrobes.

BEDROOM 2
3.13m (10.3ft) x 3.36m (11ft)
Double bedroom with built-in wardrobes.

ENTRANCE FLOOR:

KITCHEN
3.72m (12.2ft) x 3.36m (11ft)
Fully fitted kitchen with a range of wall and base units, a Bosch oven, 4 ring Indesit induction hob, integrated Candy microwave and oven. Integrated Indesit washing machine, and integrated Indesit fridge freezer. Gas boiler is housed here. Steps down to the garden area.

SHOWER ROOM
1.46m (4.9ft) x 2.37m (7.9ft)
W.C, wash-hand basin, heated towel rail, and shower cubicle with rainwater shower head.

GARDEN LEVEL:

LIVING ROOM
7.32m (24ft) x 3.36m (11ft)
A spiral staircase, marble fireplace with a timber surround creates an attractive focal point in the living space. Decorative cornicing and recessed ceiling lighting. Sliding patio doors open onto a private inner courtyard, finished with cobble-lock paving and featuring a small Barna shed for additional storage, along with a practical outdoor area ideal for relaxing or entertaining.

REAR GARDEN
The garden enjoys a paved seating area bordered by mature hydrangeas and established trees, creating a private and attractive outdoor setting. A pedestrian walkway provides independent access directly onto Baggot Lane, offering added convenience and connectivity.

•	A three storey 2 bedroom townhouse positioned in the return of 54 Pembroke Road
•	Presented in good condition
•	Gas-fired central heating 
•	Spiral staircase connects each floor
•	Extending to 71sq.m / 764sq.ft.
•	Prime location in Dublin 4
•	Rooms of gracious proportions enjoying an abundance of natural light
